items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: When me and Black Benny was... I mean me and Ray and Happy, they was the grand march.

ctx.x: So I mean the Zulu Club they turned out too. The Zulu Club turned out, they turned out too. When me and Black Benny was... I mean me and Ray and Happy, they was the grand march. And they'd never forget that.
Somebody told me they had this drum up on top of the hearse or someplace. Do you remember? Is that true? No.
